{{DISPLAYTITLE:Cooking in {{BotW|-}}}} {{BasePageLink|Cooking}} This article details the [[Cooking]] mechanisms specific to {{BotW}}. For the Cooking mechanisms of {{TotK}}, see [[Cooking in Tears of the Kingdom|Cooking in {{TotK|-}}]]. __TOC__ {{Clear}} ==Overview== [[Cooking]] is a mechanic in {{BotW}} that allows [[Link]] to combine [[Ingredient]]s in order to make [[Meal]]s. ===Roasted Food=== {{Main|Roasted Food}} When thrown on the ground near an open flame, or while within the [[Scorching Climate]] in the [[Death Mountain]] region, Materials that can recover life when eaten raw will be [[Roasted Food|Roasted]]; other Materials will simply burn to ash. Roasted Food will increase the amount of life a Material can recover by half of its base amount{{Note|Rounded to the next quarter-Heart up.}}. [[Hard-Boiled Egg|Boiling Egg]]s in [[Hot Spring]]s is another way to "roast" [[Bird Egg]]s, a method unique to them. [[Mighty Thistle]] and [[Armoranth]] can be roasted, each gaining half a heart of recovery. ===Frozen Food=== {{Main|Frozen Food}} [[Meat]] and [[Materials in Breath of the Wild#Seafood|Seafood]] will become [[Frozen Food|Frozen]] when exposed to the frigid air of mountain regions or other icy Effects. The amount of life recovered usually remains the same as the base Ingredient, though it does gain 1:00 of [[Heat Resistance]] at level 1. ===Cooked Food=== However, in order to utilize the full potential of any Ingredient Link must use a Cooking Pot. Cooking an Ingredient that can be eaten raw doubles the amount of Hearts it would otherwise provide. Some Materials can imbue Food with an [[Added Effect]], but only when used in a Cooking Pot. Up to five Materials can be held in Link's hands and thrown into the Pot. Depending on the combination of Materials, one of the following can be made as a result: *[[Meal]]s are made with only [[Fruit]], [[Mushroom]]s, [[Vegetable]]s, [[Meat]], seafood, and supplemental Materials as Ingredients. A Material's life recovery is doubled, and some have hidden recovery only available when Cooked. The kind of Meal made will depend on the combination of Materials present. If a Material has an Added Effect, it can potentially be activated. *[[Elixir]]s are the result of an infusion of at least one frog, lizard, or insect (collectively known as "critters") ''and'' one Monster Part. Any other Material that is viable for Meals can also be used in Elixirs as long as the Added Effect, if any, is the same. Life recovery is doubled and Added Effects will be activated. **[[Fairy Tonic]]s are a special type of Elixir that can occur when a [[Fairy]] assists with Cooking. Fairies will typically just add ten Hearts of life recovery to the Recipe, but they will make a Fairy Tonic for Link if there are no other kinds of Materials present, or the Recipe would normally be an Elixir, Dubious Food, or Rock-Hard Food. While Fairy Tonics will not grant Added Effects, life recovery will still be doubled. *[[Dubious Food]] and [[Rock-Hard Food]] are the results of failed Recipes from inedible Ingredient combinations. Minimal life recovery and no Added Effects will be present in these dishes. ===Life Recovery=== The amount of Hearts recovered from food prepared in a Cooking Pot is found by adding up the recovered Hearts of each Ingredient cooked on its own. However, some dishes will change the total amount of Hearts recovered that would otherwise be expected from the individual Ingredients: {{Data Table |game= BotW |responsiveModeEnabled= false |columns= Recipe [IconList], Recovery Bonus |- | Wildberry Crepe | {{HeartAmount|4|No data sort}} |- | Seafood Paella | {{HeartAmount|2|No data sort}} |- | Hot Buttered Apple | {{HeartAmount|1|No data sort}} |- | Fruitcake | {{HeartAmount|1|No data sort}} |- | Honey Crepe | {{HeartAmount|1|No data sort}} |- | Warm Milk{{List Note|Only when Fresh Milk is the sole Ingredient.}} | {{HeartAmount|0.5|No data sort}} |- | Honey Candy | {{HeartAmount|0|No data sort}}{{HeartAmount|0|No data sort}} |- | Fairy Tonic | {{HeartAmount|0|No data sort}}{{HeartAmount|0|No data sort}}{{HeartAmount|0|No data sort}} }} Some Materials will also change the total amount of expected Heart recovery: {{Data Table |game= BotW |responsiveModeEnabled= false |columns= Recipe [List:plain], Recovery Bonus |- | [[File:BotW Shard of Farosh's Horn Icon.png|32px]] [[Dragon Part|Shard of Dragon's Horn]] | {{HeartAmount|3.75|No data sort}} |- | [[File:BotW Shard of Farosh's Fang Icon.png|32px]] [[Dragon Part|Shard of Dragon's Fang]] | {{HeartAmount|2.5|No data sort}} |- | [[File:BotW Farosh's Claw Icon.png|32px]] [[Dragon Part|Dragon's Claw]] | {{HeartAmount|2|No data sort}} |- | [[File:BotW Farosh's Scale Icon.png|32px]] [[Scale|Dragon's Scales]] | {{HeartAmount|1.25|No data sort}} |- | {{Icon List|BotW| * Acorn{{List Note|name=Other Materials only|Only when Cooked with other Materials.}} }} | {{HeartAmount|1/2|No data sort}} |- | {{Icon List|BotW| * Chickaloo Tree Nut{{List Note|name=Other Materials only}} }} | {{HeartAmount|1/2|No data sort}} }} ===Critical bonus=== Every time a dish is Cooked in a [[Cooking Pot]], there is a chance for a bonus to be applied to one of the dish's properties. This critical success adds a short tune during the cooking animation. It manifests as one of the following: *{{HeartAmount|3|No data sort}} extra life recovery *5:00 added duration *Increased Effect strength **For time-based Effects, the level increases by one. **For the [[Extra Heart]]s Added Effect, the extra amount increases by one. **For the [[Extra Stamina]] and [[Stamina Recovery]] Effects, the Stamina Wheels increase by two ⅕ notches. If there is no Added Affect or duration tied to an Effect then the irrelevant bonus will never be chosen. If life recovery is already at maximum, either from the Extra Hearts Effect or from reaching thirty Hearts, then it will not be chosen. If an Effect's strength is already at maximum, it will not be chosen. If an Effect has duration, it can be chosen even if it is already at 30:00. Critical bonuses can happen naturally with a base 5% chance to occur per unique Material in the dish. Some Materials will further increase the rate on top of that, but it will only be calculated in once and only by the highest chance present. Cooking between 11:30 and 12:15 on the night of a [[Blood Moon]] will guarantee a bonus. Critical bonus chance caps at 100%; no more than one bonus can be gained per Recipe. If [[Monster Extract]] is present or the dish is Dubious or Rock-Hard Food, you cannot gain a critical bonus. {{Data Table |game= BotW |caption= Critical Bonus Chances |collapse= true |responsiveModeEnabled= false |columns= Material [List:plain], Critical bonus chance |- | [[File:BotW Shard of Farosh's Horn Icon.png|32px]] [[Dragon Part|Shard of Dragon's Horn]]

When that happens, the result is a failed Meal that restores very little Hearts and will not have any added Effects. [[Rock-Hard Food]] will only restore {{HeartAmount|0.25|No data sort}}. It occurs when any of the following Materials are present, even taking precedence over Dubious Food: {{Collapsible |header= Rock-Hard Food Materials |frame= true |content= {{Icon List|BotW| * Amber * Diamond * Flint * Luminous Stone * Opal * Ruby * Sapphire * Topaz * Wood }} }} [[Dubious Food]] will always restore at least {{HeartAmount|1|No data sort}}. The base life recovery of the Materials is added together for the total. Material recovery bonuses are not activated. Dubious Food occurs when any of the following conditions are met: *A Recipe contains a critter but not a Monster Part, or vice versa. *An Elixir contains Materials that provide different Added Effects. *An invalid combination of supplemental Materials is made: {{Collapsible |header= Supplemental Materials |frame= true |content= {{Icon List|BotW| * Bird Egg * Cane Sugar * Courser Bee Honey * Dinraal's Scale * Dinraal's Claw * Farosh's Claw * Farosh's Scale * Fresh Milk * Goat Butter * Goron Spice * Hylian Rice * Monster Extract * Naydra's Claw * Naydra's Scale * Rock Salt * Shard of Dinraal's Fang * Shard of Dinraal's Horn * Shard of Farosh's Fang * Shard of Farosh's Horn * Shard of Naydra's Fang * Shard of Naydra's Horn * Star Fragment * Tabantha Wheat }} }} **Some can be Cooked on their own for a valid Recipe: these include [[Courser Bee Honey]], [[Bird Egg]], [[Fresh Milk]], and any combination of [[Acorn]] or [[Chickaloo Tree Nut]]. **Fresh Milk and Bird Egg can be successfully Cooked with any other supplemental Ingredient. **There are preset combinations that do produce a valid combination, such as Tabantha Wheat with Rock Salt or Hateno Cheese. For more Recipes, refer to its section ([[#Recipe Logic|see below]]). ===Selling=== To calculate the [[Sell Price]] of Meals and Elixirs, first take the sum of the prices of the Materials, then multiply it by a modifier determined by the number of Ingredients. Finally, round down to the next whole number, then round up to the nearest tens digit. Fairy Tonics, Dubious Food, and Rock-Hard Food will only sell for 2 [[Rupee]]s regardless of Materials used. [[Sautéed Nuts]] made with a single Acorn will sell for 8. *1.5x for one Ingredient *1.8x for two Ingredients *2.1x for three Ingredients *2.4x for four Ingredients *2.8x for five Ingredients Dragon Parts and Star Fragments are considered as having a base sell price of 1 Rupee when Cooked. For the other Material values, see [[Materials in Breath of the Wild|Materials in {{BotW|-}}]]. Roasted and Frozen Food do not follow the conventional selling rules and rather have a set price. For Sell Prices for these Foods, see [[Food in Breath of the Wild|Food in {{BotW|-}}]]. ===Added Effect Materials=== The following Materials are categorized by which [[Added Effect]] they give. Each Material grants a certain amounts of points (represented here by ★) towards its Added Effect. If the total points contributed by all the Materials reaches certain thresholds, it will increase the level of the Added Effect provided. They extend Added Effect duration and some can increase the chance for a critical bonus. Monster Parts do not add life recovery to the Elixir, nor do they increase the Added Effect strength. Monster Parts are divided into three tiers based on the time and critical bonus chance they add: low-grade, mid-grade, and high-grade. For more information on critical bonus chance, refer to its section ([[#Critical bonus|see above]]). Special note about rarer Monster Parts: the only mechanical difference between Monster Parts of the same grade is Sell Price. [[Lynel Guts]] provide just as much added duration and critical bonus chance as a [[Bokoblin Guts|Bokoblin]]'s. Elemental Monster Parts offer no special benefits to elemental Added Effects. Dragon Parts are not considered Monster Parts. {{Data Table |collapse= true |game= BotW |responsiveModeEnabled= false |columns= Low-grade 1:10 [IconList], Mid-grade 1:50 [IconList], High-grade 3:10 [IconList] |- | Bokoblin Horn | Bokoblin Fang | Bokoblin Guts |- | Moblin Horn | Moblin Fang | Moblin Guts |- | Lizalfos Horn | Lizalfos Talon | Lizalfos Tail, Red Lizalfos Tail, Yellow Lizalfos Tail, Icy Lizalfos Tail |- | Chuchu Jelly | Red Chuchu Jelly, Yellow Chuchu Jelly, White Chuchu Jelly | N/A |- | Keese Wing | Fire Keese Wing, Electric Keese Wing, Ice Keese Wing | Keese Eyeball |- | Octo Balloon, Octorok Tentacle | Octorok Eyeball | N/A |- | Hinox Toenail | Hinox Tooth | Hinox Guts |- | N/A | Molduga Fin | Molduga Guts |- | Lynel Horn | Lynel Hoof | Lynel Guts |- | Ancient Spring, Ancient Screw | Ancient Gear, Ancient Shaft | Giant Ancient Core, Ancient Core }} ===Monster Extract=== [[Monster Extract]] will remove any chance of a critical bonus and instead have random changes on expected properties of a dish. Effect duration will be set to 1:00, 10:00, or 30:00. Only neutral Materials can add more, but their duration will reduced by 0:30. Between life recovery and Effect strength, one will be chosen to receive either a positive or negative change. If one property is not present, then the other is guaranteed to be changed. The Extra Hearts Effect will always have the strength changed by Monster Extract, never life recovery. *The negative change reduces the affected property to its lowest value: **Life recovery is set to {{HeartAmount|0.25|No data sort}}. **Effect strength is set to one ★. *The positive change increases the affected property by an amount dependent on what was chosen: **Life recovery increases by {{HeartAmount|3|No data sort}}. **For time-based Effects, its level increases by one. **For the Extra Hearts Effect, the extra amount increases by one. **For the Extra Stamina and Stamina Recovery Effects, the stamina wheels increase by two ⅕ notches. Even if life recovery is reduced, recovery bonuses from Recipes and Materials will still be applied. ===Recipe Logic=== In order to determine which Recipe a Meal becomes, the Materials are compared against the required Ingredients for each one until a match is found. Only one of each unique Material is considered; [[Fruitcake]] must be made with one Apple or Wildberry ''and'' one of the other listed Fruits that hasn't been used yet, while Copious Fried Wild Greens must be made with four different types of Vegetable. The search will begin from the highest priority Recipe following the tables below.
